'''Ryūzaburō Ōtomo''' (Japanese: '''大友龍三郎''' ''Ōtomo Ryūzaburō'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Ōtomo was born on May 18, 1952, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}. As an adult, he became a voice actor and led a long voice acting career since the mid-1970s. For {{aniseries|PTS}}, Ōtomo initially voiced [[Muramasa]], a [[character of the day]] who appeared in {{aniseries|GS}}; and {{DL|Corey|Bruteroot|Corey's Venusaur}}, [[nickname]]d Bruteroot, in [[M01|the first movie]]. He then voiced [[Snowbelle City]] [[Gym Leader]] [[Wulfric]] during {{aniseries|XY}}. He has affiliations with the talent agencies {{wp|Aoni Production}} and {{wp|81 Produce}}, as well as the {{wp|Tokyo Actor's Consumer's Cooperative Society}}.
